scope: Gathering version-2 documentation, live WithAName collection, MISP feed ingestion and screenshots. Earlier MISP 3.0 examples retain their separate provenance.

misp.role: Site administrator in an isolated local documentation database

module_service.runtime: Checked-out module source running with the existing Python 3.12 documentation-container dependencies; current proxy and CA bundle supplied, with TLS verification enabled.

collection.data: Actual public historical source configurations; no synthetic replacement or source-response mocking. Listed target systems were not contacted.

verification.feed_fetched_via: Authenticated MISP POST /feeds/fetchFromFeed/3, synchronous MISP importer with background generation in misp-modules
remaining_limits: The saved form was inspected in Overmind; saving from that modal was not exercised. Classic browser form submission returned a CSRF error in the local fixture, so feed creation and fetch used the authenticated API. No form security checks were disabled.
Database-backed scheduled background feed workers were not exercised.
Restart recovery, historical source corrections and large-feed budgets were source-reviewed rather than rerun for this documentation change.

capture_method: Headless system Chromium via Playwright against the running local MISP application. Actual saved feed edit modal and actual imported event list; no DOM data substitution, image generation or image retouching.

shots.description: Saved feed opened in the actual Overmind edit modal; the screenshot stops before Save Changes.
Actual imported snapshot events with timestamps, unpublished state, and attribute/object counts.
